prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: reusable transparent product cutout for an artist-jeweller website design study
Primary request: Create one believable handmade sterling-silver ring as a clean isolated product image.
Subject: a single sculptural silver ring with a gently irregular, hand-shaped band and subtle tool marks; restrained and contemporary, not ornate, no gemstone.
Style/medium: high-end but tactile editorial product photography, realistic metal rather than a glossy 3D render.
Composition/framing: square canvas, ring shown at a calm three-quarter angle so both the circular opening and the thickness of the band are clearly readable; centered with generous transparent space on every side; complete ring fully visible.
Lighting/mood: soft directional studio light that defines the silver form while remaining adaptable over light, dark, photographic, and illustrated backgrounds.
Color palette: natural sterling silver only.
Materials/textures: softly polished silver with tiny handmade irregularities and believable reflections.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background with a clean alpha edge; no floor, no backdrop, no cast shadow, no reflection below the object, no hand, no box, no props, no text, no logo, no watermark, no cropped edges, no duplicate objects. The ring must remain visually legible when composited over another image.
